Government of Himachal Pradesh **Respondents** Corrigendum in Petition No.310/GT/2018 Page 1 of 3 ## ** CORRIGENDUM ** This Petition was filed by the Petitioner, SJVNL for revision of annual fixed charges of Nathpa Jhakri Hydro Power Station (1500 MW) for the period from 1.4.2004 to 31.3.2009 and the Commission by order dated 9.4.2019 determined the same. Certain inadvertent typographical errors had crept in some paragraphs of the said order and the same is rectified as under: (a) Para 78 of the order shall stand modified as under: _“78. The tariff recovered from the respondents in accordance with the earlier orders of this Commission shall be adjusted in light of the final tariff now approved by us.
